name: Learn 5 AI words, take the check, cards get scheduled

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) { document.querySelector('.opt').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); if (!document.querySelector('#fb .feedback')) return false; document.querySelector('[data-act=next]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); } return !!document.querySelector('.result'); })()

name: Grammar lesson: all three exercise types work

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let n = 0; n < 6; n++) { if (document.querySelector('.opt')) document.querySelector('.opt').click(); else if (document.querySelector('#ans')) { const i = document.querySelector('#ans'); i.value = 'the'; document.querySelector('[data-act=check]').click(); } else if (document.querySelector('#pool')) { document.querySelectorAll('#pool .wbtn').forEach(b => b.click()); await w(50); document.querySelector('[data-act=check]').click(); } await w(120); if (!document.querySelector('#fb .feedback')) return 'no feedback at ' + n; document.querySelector('[data-act=next]').click(); await w(120); } return !!document.querySelector('.result'); })()

name: Order exercise builds the right sentence

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) { if (document.querySelector('.opt')) document.querySelector('.opt').click(); else { document.querySelector('#ans').value = 'x'; document.querySelector('[data-act=check]').click(); } await w(80); document.querySelector('[data-act=next]').click(); await w(80); } const want = 'I am learning English now'.split(' '); for (const word of want) { [...document.querySelectorAll('#pool .wbtn:not(.used)')].find(b => b.textContent === word).click(); await w(30); } document.querySelector('[data-act=check]').click(); await w(100); return document.querySelector('#fb .feedback.ok') !== null; })()
